description: The bar chart illustrates the task count for different language families, categorized by which model performed better. The horizontal axis contains the categories, representing language groups ordered alphabetically: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "task count," with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40 and tick labels at intervals of 10, accompanied by horizontal grid lines. The chart features grouped vertical bars, where each group corresponds to a language family on the horizontal axis. Within each group, up to three bars are arranged side-by-side, representing the categories defined in the legend titled "better": "mBERT" (light blue), "XLM-R" (dark blue), and "same" (light green). All bars are visually emphasized with black outlines. The values vary across the language groups and performance categories. The tallest bar in the chart represents XLM-R for the IE-Slavic group, reaching a task count of approximately 39. The shortest visible bars have a value of approximately 1, such as mBERT for IE-Indic, IE-other, Isolate, and Uralic, as well as "same" for Isolate and Semitic. There are no visible bars for mBERT in the IE-Baltic and Semitic groups, indicating a value of 0. Other notable high values include "same" for IE-Romance at exactly 30 and "same" for IE-Slavic at approximately 28.
